jobs.description:
At KMD, we build digital solutions used by millions of people around the world. These solutions are the digital foundations of our most important institutions, from governments and public services to financial industries and private companies. Our mission is to ensure that they are reliable, accessible, and efficient.

We believe that the future is what you make it. So a career at KMD is a career with purpose and freedom. One where you’ll have a direct hand in improving the lives of people, while being empowered with the resources and autonomy to shape the course of your own professional journey.

Join Charlie Tango, a specialised unit within KMD

Charlie Tango is a multidisciplinary consultancy within KMD, bringing together around 40 specialists across design, strategy, technology, AI and innovation.

Together, we combine Charlie Tango’s hands-on approach to design and innovation with KMD’s deep domain knowledge and experience developing critical digital solutions that help shape the future of society.

AI is transforming how we explore ideas, create experiences and build digital products. At the same time, growing complexity demands stronger design systems, smarter processes and a more systematic approach to design.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer who is excited by both. Someone with excellent visual and UI design skills, a strong understanding of UX, and a genuine passion for design craft, combined with a deep interest in the systems, processes and practices that enable great design at scale.

Be part of our multidisciplinary design team

You will join our Product Design team, part of Charlie Tango’s Experience Design department of approximately 15 designers, spanning UX, Service Design, UI, Motion Design and Branding.Your primary focus will be on UI, interaction design and design systems, working closely with our Service & UX Design team, frontend developers and product owners.

Your role

As a Senior Product Designer, you will take a leading role in shaping digital products, experiences and the practices behind them. You will take ownership of the design process, working from user needs and business challenges through concepts, interactions and high-quality visual execution.

You are a hands-on designer who can navigate complex challenges, facilitate collaboration and advise clients on how to improve their design practices.

With a particular focus on Process Design, Design Systems, DesignOps and Accessibility, you will help organisations develop and implement better ways of working, while remaining closely involved in the design work itself.

Your work will typically include:

• Creating digital products and interfaces. Develop high-quality visual and interaction design, from concepts and prototypes to detailed UI and production-ready designs.

• Designing processes and ways of working. Map workflows, identify challenges and develop practical processes that improve collaboration, decision-making and delivery.

• Building and evolving Design Systems. Develop components, design standards and governance models, and help organisations implement and adopt them.

• Advancing DesignOps and Accessibility. Help clients establish effective design practices, accessibility standards and processes that support consistent, inclusive digital experiences.

• Facilitating and advising. Lead workshops, collaborate with stakeholders and translate complex needs into clear design directions and practical solutions.

• Exploring AI in design. Use AI-assisted tools and automation in your own work, experiment with new workflows and help clients identify opportunities to improve their design processes.

• Developing our design practice. Share knowledge, challenge existing methods and contribute to the development of our Experience Design team.

What you bring

We imagine you have 5+ years of relevant experience, ideally from a consultancy, agency or complex product organisation. You are first and foremost a skilled visual and digital product designer, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong UI craft, attention to detail and experience creating digital products and working with large-scale design systems.

In detail:

• Excellent visual and UI design skills, including typography, colour, layout, interaction patterns, prototyping and detailed interface design.

• A strong understanding of UX, user behaviour and the principles of human-centred design.

• A systematic and analytical mindset, with a genuine interest in Process Design, workflows and improving how teams work.

• Practical experience with Design Systems and DesignOps, including components, governance, implementation and cross-functional collaboration.

• Deep accessibility expertise, including WCAG and the ability to independently advise on inclusive design and its implementation.

• Strong facilitation and consultancy skills, with the confidence to work directly with clients and multidisciplinary teams.

• Advanced Figma skills, and an active interest in AI-assisted design workflows and emerging technologies.

• Excellent communication skills in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

Why join Charlie Tango?

At Charlie Tango, you become part of a close-knit specialist environment with the reach and opportunities of a major technology organisation as part of KMD.

You will work on meaningful digital challenges across public and private sectors, including solutions that support essential functions in Danish society. You will collaborate with experienced designers, advisors and engineers in an environment that values craft, curiosity, precision and new ideas.

You will also join at a time when AI and emerging technologies are changing both what we design and how we design it, creating opportunities to explore new approaches and influence the future of our practice.

We offer a high degree of professional autonomy, varied challenges and opportunities for professional development and knowledge sharing.

You will be employed by KMD in a full-time position, based at Charlie Tango's office in Østerbro, Copenhagen, with a competitive salary package, pension and employee benefits in accordance with KMD's employment terms. You will report to the Head of Design.

Interested?

We would love to see how you think, how you work, what you have created and how you envision an AI-driven future.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so send us your CV (or LinkedIn profile) and a link to your portfolio, ideally including examples of digital product design as well as work involving Design Systems, Process Design, DesignOps or Accessibility.

Applications are handled through KMD's recruitment process. Please note that response times may be slightly longer than usual. Thank you for your patience and understanding. We welcome qualified candidates from different backgrounds and experiences.

Come help us design digital experiences that matter, and shape how we design them.

Benefits:

KMD (an NEC company) is committed to providing equal opportunities. Hence, we invite all qualified interested applicants to apply for career opportunities. At KMD all aspects of employment and cooperation including the decision to hire/cooperate with will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other status protected under local anti-discrimination legislation.

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Engineers - Substations and Export Cables
jobs.description:
Business Area Wind is responsible for Vattenfall’s Onshore and Offshore Wind, as well as other non-hydro renewable initiatives like PV/Solar and batteries. We currently develop, construct and operate wind generation assets across Sweden, Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands and the UK.

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets. You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

We are looking for several Senior Project Engineers to strengthen our offshore transmission engineering capabilities within Business Area Wind, Offshore, Engineering.

We are seeking engineers with experience in one or more of the following areas:

• Offshore substations

• Onshore substations

• Offshore export cables

• Onshore export cables

We welcome engineers from all relevant disciplines across these scopes, with particular interest in HV and LV systems for onshore and offshore substations, and civil engineering for onshore substations and onshore export cable routes. Your assigned scope will reflect your background and experience.

You will take ownership of assigned engineering work packages, from FEED and tendering through delivery and handover.

In these roles, you will apply your experience to shape and challenge supplier solutions from the owner’s perspective, coordinate technical expertise and resolve delivery issues.

Within the project, you will report to the respective Package Manager and work autonomously within your assigned scope, drawing on technical specialists and collaborating with Interface Managers, Procurement and other project functions.

Your responsibilities:

• 
Deliver assigned engineering work packages in accordance with contractual requirements and project and contract milestones. Plan and coordinate activities, and monitor and report on safety, quality, progress and cost within your scope.

• 
Apply a systems engineering mindset so decisions within your scope support the performance, integration, optimisation and delivery of the overall transmission system—not individual contracts in isolation.

• 
Keep the design basis, requirements, interface decisions and contractual scope aligned, coordinating the impact of changes on affected packages.

• 
Work with Interface Managers and project teams to define and resolve technical and contractual interfaces, including scope boundaries, engineering inputs and delivery dependencies.

• 
Assess supplier proposals and technical decisions with safety as the highest, non-negotiable priority. Consider functionality, availability, quality, constructability and maintainability alongside CAPEX, OPEX, schedule and delivery risk.

• 
Coordinate technical specialist input and challenge unnecessary complexity and over-specification in supplier solutions.

• 
Identify and manage scope-related risks and opportunities, maintain an up-to-date risk and opportunity register, and coordinate mitigation. Keep technical positions, assumptions, deviations and residual risks visible throughout the project lifecycle.

• 
Support supplier qualification and technical evaluation. Incorporate Employer’s Requirements and specialist input into tender documentation, making scope boundaries and interface requirements clear. Assess bids, deviations and assumptions to support negotiations and award.

• 
Follow supplier engineering while respecting supplier design responsibility. Coordinate technical reviews, verify supplier documentation against contractual requirements, and resolve technical queries, deviations and changes with relevant stakeholders. Align technical decisions with the respective Technical Authority.

• 
Coordinate manufacturing or construction quality surveillance, inspections and acceptance testing, including FAT where applicable. Verify supplier documentation and technical completion, and support construction and commissioning teams in resolving technical issues and ensuring interface readiness. Verify as-built documentation and support taking-over, handover and close-out for safe, reliable and efficient operation and maintenance.

• 
Share lessons learned and contribute to improving requirements, engineering practices and project delivery.

We welcome applications from candidates at either Intermediate or Senior level. For Intermediate-level candidates, we are particularly interested in individuals who demonstrate strong technical capabilities, a high level of motivation, and a willingness to learn and develop further

Location: The role will be based in one of Vattenfall’s office locations in Kolding (Denmark), Amsterdam (Netherlands) or Hamburg (Germany). Some travel to other Vattenfall offices, project locations, supplier facilities and construction sites should be expected.

Qualifications

Your profile:

• B.Sc. or M.Sc. in electrical engineering, power engineering, structural engineering, civil engineering, mechanical engineering or another relevant engineering discipline.

• At least five years of relevant engineering experience, including responsibility for electrical, structural, civil or mechanical engineering work packages in the development or delivery of one or more of the following: onshore or offshore HV substations, subsea export cable systems or onshore HV cable systems. Owner-side experience is preferred.

• Experience in major project development or delivery, including technical oversight, interface coordination or acceptance of supplier work. Experience in multi-contract delivery, where the owner retains responsibility for integration across suppliers and packages, is preferred.

• Experience reviewing and challenging supplier and contractor engineering, including interfaces with other disciplines, fabrication, construction and installation.

• A systems engineering mindset, demonstrated by resolving interfaces between disciplines, suppliers and packages in the interests of the overall transmission system.

• Strong safety and engineering judgement, including the ability to distinguish essential requirements from unnecessary complexity.

• Commercial awareness of how technical choices affect CAPEX, OPEX, schedule, contractual risk and project delivery.

• Self-motivated and able to work autonomously, with good communication and influencing skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines and packages.

• Professional working proficiency in English.

• Willingness to travel to project, supplier and construction locations as required.

Additional Information

Our offer

We offer an international and collaborative working environment, attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development. You will work with experienced colleagues across disciplines and be encouraged to ask questions, share knowledge and contribute to continuous improvement.

More Information

Incoming applications are reviewed and evaluated on an ongoing basis. Therefore, this vacancy may be filled before the application deadline. The application deadline is November 29, 2026.

We welcome your application in English and kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.

For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Sandra Domschke (sandra1.domschke@vattenfall.de) or Adam Hammond (adam.hammond@vattenfall.com).

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to building a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be a good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation. Click here for further information.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. A pre-employment screening will therefore form part of the recruitment process and will reflect the requirements of the role. The screening will be conducted by a third party, DISA Global Solutions AB.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 20 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

jobs.occupation: Join us as a Student Data Engineer in Fund Accounting Products
jobs.description:
Would you like to put your studies into practice in an AI-first engineering environment and work with data engineering and AI-assisted development that creates real business value? Would you like to build your technical skills while contributing to solutions used across Nykredit? Then you might be our new Student Data Engineer in Fund Accounting Products.

As a Student Data Engineer in Fund Accounting Products, you will play an important role in our team, helping us build reports, automate processes and develop the data flows and platforms that support fund valuation, alternatives and fund accounting.

Nykredit is investing heavily in AI, and our team takes an AI-first approach. We actively consider how AI can help us code, test and solve problems more efficiently, while taking responsibility for the quality of the results.

You will also become part of the Nykredit Group, where we offer opportunities and development for those who are curious and eager to learn. Through our student network, Nykredit Youth, you will be invited to professional events and networking opportunities with other students and young colleagues across the Group.

Are you motivated by data engineering and new technologies?

Then you have come to the right place. Your focus will be on reports, data processing, event-driven streaming pipelines and the platforms supporting our business domains.

You will work with technologies such as Python, SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Apache Spark, Azure and Kafka, alongside colleagues using GitHub, Terraform and Grafana for development, deployment and monitoring. These are technologies you will have the opportunity to work with and learn about, not a checklist of things you need to know before applying.

Your tasks will include:

• Developing and improving reports used by the business.

• Preparing, transforming and validating financial data.

• Automating manual tasks using Python and SQL.

• Helping build and test event-driven streaming pipelines and integrations using Kafka.Working with SimCorp Dimension and bringing its data into our Wealth Data Hub.

• Improving monitoring and automation of data flows and operational tasks.

• Exploring how AI can help us modernise legacy code, automate operations and improve data quality.

• Investigating data quality issues and improving existing solutions.

You will start with well-defined tasks and gradually take on more responsibility as you learn, working alongside experienced engineers on real deliveries.

The position is 10–15 hours per week at our headquarters, Nykredit Huset, Sundkrogsgade 25 in Nordhavn, where most of the team is based.

**AI as part of your everyday work

**We work with an AI-first approach: when tackling a task, we actively consider how AI can help us solve it better and more efficiently, while taking responsibility for the quality of the result.

You will get hands-on experience with AI-assisted tools and platforms for coding, testing, documentation and troubleshooting. Together with experienced colleagues, you will explore how AI can help modernise legacy code, automate repetitive work and improve data quality.

We encourage you to experiment and bring your own ideas while learning to understand, review and validate AI-generated output. You do not need experience with specific AI tools before joining us. We will help you get started.

**Are you the one we are looking for?

**We imagine that you:

• are studying Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or a related field,

• have some experience with Python and SQL from coursework, personal projects or a previous student job,

• enjoy solving problems and working carefully with data,

• are comfortable asking questions and sharing what you learn,

• are curious about AI-assisted development and keen to use it in practice,

• are willing to experiment with AI while questioning, reviewing and understanding the output and code you work with.

We know you are still studying, so we do not expect you to know everything from day one. No financial background is needed, and familiarity with Git, cloud platforms or reporting projects is useful but not required.

What matters most is your curiosity and willingness to learn alongside experienced colleagues. In your application, we would therefore like to hear about a project or assignment you have worked on, how you approached it and what you learned.

Your new team

You will join Fund Accounting Products in Nykredit Wealth Technology, where engineers and specialists work closely with the business.

We are modernising our solutions through the re-implementation of SimCorp Dimension, new SaaS solutions and the replacement of existing in-house systems. You will contribute to both existing solutions and new deliveries, with guidance from experienced colleagues and opportunities to learn how financial requirements translate into working code and reliable data.

We look forward to welcoming you as our new colleague.

**Want to know more?

**You are welcome to contact Development Manager Søren Valther Rasmussen at +45 44 55 51 42 if you have any questions about the position.

If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact the recruitment team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

Job Title: Management Coordinator (Maternity Cover)

Your impact begins here

As Management Coordinator (Maternity Cover), you will keep management support running smoothly across budgets, HR, meetings, events and communication in API Quality M1 and API Quality M2. You will act as the extended arm of management, making sure decisions are executed, changes are finished properly and processes keep improving. Your work gives leaders room to focus on priorities and gives colleagues clarity on what happens next, so the department keeps moving with pace and quality. Whether you see this as the next step in your career or as a one-year development opportunity, you will have the chance to learn, build your network and make an impact.

What you’ll bring

You bring a service mindset, sound business understanding and the initiative to keep things moving.

• 
Office education or another relevant education.

• 
A high level of business understanding.

• 
A strong service mindset and the ability to build and use networks.

• 
Readiness for change, and the confidence to support others through it.

• 
Independence and initiative in prioritizing, planning and carrying out tasks, whether assigned by management or started by you.

• 
Fluency in English, as you will work with colleagues and stakeholders across the department.

• 
Experience supporting a management team or director in a coordination or assistant role.

• 
Familiarity with the most common Novo systems, budget follow-up or HR processes.

What you’ll do

This is a broad role that sits close to management. You will make sure budgets, people processes, communication and planning all work together, and that decisions turn into action.

• Act as the extended arm of management and a trusted sparring partner. You will drive and support change management processes, take part in transformation initiatives and make sure changes are implemented and finalized correctly and timely.

• Support management with communication tasks by preparing, proofreading and refining presentations, announcements and all other communication materials.

• Secure timely budget and manning preparations and monthly follow-ups for the departments. You will also plan and take part in various budget meetings and handle all purchasing within your approval rights in Coupa.

• Be the key support on HR processes such as promotions, organizational changes, contract handling, onboarding and personal cases, including acting as power of attorney for directors and managers in relevant systems.

• Plan the director’s annual calendar, department meetings and events across API Quality and drive the management team’s annual cycle activities across the departments.

• Ad hoc administrative tasks, such as taking part in the secretariat during inspections and audits, contribute to relevant projects, and give daily support to colleagues and stakeholders, guiding them to help themselves.

Who you’ll work with

You will join API Manufacturing Quality, where colleagues collaborate across the Novo Nordisk value chain to support high quality and responsible ways of working.

In this role, you will support two departments (approx. 40-50 employees each) called API Quality M1 and API Quality M2 and work closely directly with both management teams. The departments are around 40-50 employees each. You will join an engaged environment and collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, gaining insight into daily operations and the processes that support management decisions.

You will also be part of administrative networks across API Quality, API IO and EITQ, where you can exchange knowledge, share best practices and Identify opportunities to simplify and improve processes and ways of working.

The position is based in Kalundborg.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to take ownership and make your voice heard. The role gives you room to use your initiative, improve procedures, quality and service, and grow your skills through projects and exchange with colleagues in the networks. You will contribute where decisions are made, with clear expectations and support to perform at your best.

This is a maternity cover position for a year.

Do you enjoy transforming business challenges into scalable, production-ready solutions?

At VENZO, we’re expanding our Data & AI team and are looking for experienced profiles across mid-to-senior level — from strong hands-on engineers to technical leaders who can shape architecture and guide others.

If you want your work to move beyond experimentation and into real-world implementation, this could be the right place for you.

At VENZO, we believe in the power of technology to create meaningful change – today, not tomorrow.

You’ll join a team of specialists who live and breathe digital transformation, helping some of Denmark’s largest and most influential organizations turn data into action. Here, innovation isn’t a buzzword – it’s how we think, collaborate, and deliver.

You will contribute directly to the design, development, and deployment of advanced data and AI systems in cloud-based environments.

Your responsibilities may include:

• Architecting and implementing end-to-end AI and machine learning solutions

• Deploying, monitoring, and optimizing models on cloud platforms

• Translating business requirements into structured technical solutions

• Ensuring solutions are maintainable, scalable, and aligned with best practices

• Evaluating and applying emerging technologies within AI and GenAI

For more senior candidates, the role also includes:

• Defining technical direction and architectural standards

• Acting as a primary technical contact for clients

• Leading workstreams and mentoring team members

• Contributing to the evolution of our Data & AI capabilities and service offerings

We value profiles who can combine deep technical execution with sound judgment in real client environments.

Your Background

We are open to different experience levels, provided you bring strong fundamentals and practical experience.

Experience and Education

• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience

• 2+ years of experience in data engineering or AI/ML, delivering production-ready solutions

• Hands-on experience across the full ML lifecycle — from experimentation to deployment and monitoring

• Experience with generative AI

• Programming: Python and SQL, Typescript is a plus

• Cloud: Microsoft Azure (e.g., Azure ML, Data Factory) or other cloud plattforms

• Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow)

• Machine Learning: Classical ML techniques and generative AI applications

• GenAI Tooling: LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, frameworks such as LangChain or Microsoft Agent Framework

• MLOps: CI/CD, model lifecycle management, orchestration tools, version control

How You Work

• Comfortable operating in client-facing environments

• Able to communicate complex technical topics in business-relevant terms

• Pragmatic, quality-driven, and accountable for outcomes

What You Can Expect From Us

• Meaningful, technically challenging projects with real business visibility

• A strong professional environment with high standards and high trust

• Autonomy in how you structure and deliver your work

• Access to modern tooling, platforms, and certifications (including Microsoft)

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits

• Continuous development — technically and professionally

Let’s Talk

Strong knowledge of SailPoint IdentityIQ architecture, integrations and capabilities in a large, complex enterprise environment.

In-depth knowledge of Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including how these technologies interact with identity governance and administration services.

Experience analysing business requirements and translating them into user stories, acceptance criteria and clear functional specifications for technical teams.

• 
A relevant degree in information security, computer science, engineering, data science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 
Experience working with external vendors or outsourced service providers to resolve incidents and deliver sustainable improvements.

•

The WindConnect (wind farm control and integration in sector-coupled power systems https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101227683) consortium unites leading experts from academia and industry across Europe, leveraging expertise in wind energy, power systems, power electronics, control engineering, artificial intelligence, and energy economics. AAU Energy is a dynamic engineering research department in continuous growth and inspiring surroundings. AAU Energy has a very international environment and covers all areas of clean and sustainable energy systems of the future within electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technology. AAU Energy has campuses in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, this position is located in Aalborg.

The mission is to be world leading in both research and research-based education of the energy engineers of the future. AAU Energy has approx. 300 employees of many nationalities, of which 25 are administrative staff. In addition, AAU Energy constantly has approx. 50-70 guest researchers from around the world.

Research and teaching are in the absolute world elite in the field of energy, and we have extensive and leading workshop and laboratory facilities, where research and innovation are carried out in direct collaboration with industry to a great extent.

The position is offered in relation to the research program "Power Electronic Control Reliability and System Optimization" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems”.

The increasing integration of wind turbine generators significantly alters power system dynamics, particularly under grid fault conditions. While grid-forming (GFM) wind turbine generators contribute to voltage and frequency regulation, they may exhibit significant nonlinear large-signal behaviour during disturbances, including current limiting, control mode switching, and loss of synchronism. In multi-converter systems, these transient dynamics are further shaped by interactions among multiple GFM units and the surrounding grid strength. Conventional small-signal models are therefore inadequate, motivating large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis frameworks for GFM wind turbine generators under grid faults.

This poses the following key research questions:

• How can large-signal models of GFM wind turbine generators be developed to accurately capture nonlinear dynamics, particularly current limiting and control mode transitions during grid faults?
• How do multiple wind turbine generators interact during grid faults, and how do grid strength and system configurations influence their transient stability?
• What are the dominant dynamic mechanisms governing transient stability, and how can reduced-order models be developed while preserving the essential nonlinear dynamics and stability characteristics?
This project will be in close collaboration with Ørsted. The PhD student is expected to work closely with colleagues from Ørsted and visit their facilities. The aim of this PhD project is to develop large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis methods for wind turbine generators under grid fault conditions, with particular emphasis on multi-inverter systems. The project seeks to identify key mechanisms affecting transient stability and to provide modelling and analysis tools that support robust control and protection design for future wind-dominated power systems.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

jobs.description:
The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) at Aarhus University, Denmark, invites applications for an exciting two-year postdoctoral position in the field of quantitative genetics and genomics applied to inbreeding management in livestock populations. The primary focus of this position is to investigate the genetic bases of inbreeding depression in dairy cattle.

Expected start date and duration of employment
This is a two-year position starting on 1 April 2027, or as soon as possible. 

Job description
This is an opportunity to integrate a top research environment and contribute to advancing the state of the art in inbreeding management, while working within a collaborative project involving key industry partners.

The overarching objective of the project is to quantify the impact of inbreeding depression load on economically important traits in dairy cattle breeds and to investigate whether recessive variants contributing to inbreeding depression segregate in genomic regions experiencing rapid accumulation of inbreeding. Particular attention will be given to regions surrounding monogenetic traits (e.g. polled locus, milk caseins) which have been subjected to strong selection pressure in recent years.

You will apply state-of-the-art quantitative genetic and genomic modelling approaches to evaluate the effect of inbreeding depression on a broad range of production and functional traits recorded in dairy cattle populations. To support these analyses, you will have access to extensive databases containing phenotypic records routinely collected on farm, as well as large-scale pedigree and SNP genomic datasets currently used in genomic evaluations. High-density SNP genotyping and whole-genome sequence data will also be available to search for causal variants and more finely describe the genetic architecture of inbreeding depression in dairy cattle. Ultimately, the project aims to incorporate these findings into practical mating software readily available to dairy farmers. Therefore, these activities will be carried out in close collaboration with industry partners to ensure practical implementation in the field. 

Within this position, the successful candidate will also have the opportunity to contribute to other research projects related to genetic diversity management and quantitative trait modelling across other livestock species. 

Your profile
• A Ph.D. in Quantitative Genetics, Population Genetics or similar.
• Good programming skills (R, Python or Julia)
• Experience in the use of software to estimate variance components is a plus (e.g. DMU, BLUPF90 or similar) 
• A team player and a good communicator
• A good track record of publication in international peer-reviewed journals
• Fluent in English (written and spoken)
Who we are
The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) is a major center for research and education in quantitative genetics and genomics at Aarhus University (http://www.qgg.au.dk/en). We conduct basic and applied research in animal, plant, and human genetics. Our focus areas include quantitative genetics, artificial intelligence applied to agriculture and medicine, population genetics, and integrative genomics. Research within QGG is characterized by a very close synergy between method development and application on practical problems across species, in collaboration with industry partners. QGG is an international research center with about 70 employees and visiting researchers from over 15 nations. QGG works in teams and strives for an excellent working environment, in which we value self-leadership, open communication, and commitment to diversity and inclusion.

What we offer

• An international research environment characterized by collaboration, professionalism, commitment to diversity and inclusion.
• Computational resources, including access to the GenomeDK high-performance computing cluster.
• A healthy work-life balance.

All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.
